observation_unit: one hourly CERES grid cell; original timestamp and coordinates retained

exclusions.water_paths: Phase-dependent retrieval availability; missing is not zero. Diagnostic only.
exclusions.other_vertical_properties: Avoid duplicate weighting of strongly correlated vertical structure; diagnostic only.
exclusions.phase: Aggregated phase index; reserve for sensitivity analysis, not a categorical liquid/ice label.
exclusions.layer_properties: Substantial layer-dependent missingness; no absent-cloud or layer-additivity assumptions.
exclusions.coordinates_and_time: Identifiers and audit strata only; never distance features.

missingness: Complete valid cloudy cases only; retain all observations, missing/invalid masks and exclusion status. No imputation. Indicators are audit metadata, not model features.
clear_definition: Valid total cloud area exactly zero; positive-area incomplete retrievals are not called clear.
seasonal_policy: Identical feature definitions and order; future fitted objects must remain season-specific.
